test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the mother of B'

A - B means 'A is the brother of B'

A × B means 'A is the wife of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'

Based on the above, how is M related to O if 'K ÷ L × M - N + O'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 Father
 
 

**Given statement :** K ÷ L × M - N + O

So,

 
• K ÷ L → K is the father of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e1fdcc966fc18a8e143d4874f0c9ea89add4157405ffb0cc306f299e27fbfe.png] 

 
• L × M → L is the wife of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df63ebc213c259bf8471fab5e47eeb7f105c0c6887de9967700f537c507e81b8.png] 

 
• M - N → M is the brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb8381064a7d1266d9a49b4171429fb1c9978a163212b65584bdbfc6f477ae05.png] 

 
• N + O → N is the mother of O.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/606c1d2c2fb48229b1bc37c2a711179007ed3e036d1b23f6242c965e69a9ba64.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree M is the maternal uncle i.e mother's brother of O.

Hence, "**Mother's brother**" is the correct answer.
